seo.title: Customer stories — how Nepali stores grow with Stella
seo.description: From boutique fashion in Patan to electronics across Kathmandu, see how merchants run their stores on Stella's commerce backend — and what changed after they switched.

hero.headline:
Real stores.
Real numbers.
hero.sub: The merchants below run their catalog, checkout, and customer accounts on Stella. Here is what happened in the months after they switched.
hero.supportingLine: Want to be the next story? We onboard new merchants every week.

featured.headline: Cut checkout abandonment by more than half — without changing a single product page.
featured.body: After moving from a stitched-together stack onto Stella in nine days, returning shoppers no longer had to re-enter address and payment details — and the cart stopped dropping orders.
featured.imageAlt: Handwoven textiles and apparel on display in a boutique
featured.quote: We thought we needed more traffic. It turned out we needed a checkout that did not fall over. Stella replaced four tools, and the difference showed up in the first week.

stories.outcome: Consolidated three storefronts into one catalog with live stock across all of them.
Launched a subscription program for monthly bean delivery in under two weeks.
Migrated from a custom WordPress build with zero downtime and kept every SEO ranking.

stories.imageAlt: Modern furniture in a styled living room
stories.outcome: Added WhatsApp ordering on top of the storefront — same catalog, same checkout.

stories.imageAlt: Hiking gear and backpack on a mountain trail
stories.outcome: Opened a B2B portal for trekking agencies alongside their consumer storefront.
Replaced a manual order book with real-time orders, eSewa, and Khalti on day one.

closing.headline: Run your store on the same backend they did.
closing.sub: A 15-minute walkthrough is enough to see whether Stella fits. No commitment, no slide deck.
